notes: Per-spec leveling reservations (sim-accuracy round 10). Below 60 a band's talent build is the guide's level-60 build cut down by the top-row-down walk (sim/leveling LadderTalentString). A spec listed here takes these ranks of its own tree first, in order, each once the build can legally hold it and never past the guide's own rank for that talent, then walks as before; so the ladder only ever adds points and its level-60 build is the guide's. A row is adopted only where the band builds it makes beat the plain walk's beyond error at seeds 1 and 50001 (10,000 iterations, the band's own heal profile, both factions), keep every talent the engine models only by a probe as zero, drop nothing the rotation casts and lose at no band. The evidence is in design/reviews/2026-11-03-sim-audit-round10/healprofile.md and design/reviews/2026-11-03-sim-audit-round11/healprofile.md. sim/leveling embeds a copy (make ladder-first-sync); TestEmbeddedLadderFirstMatchesCurated holds it to this file.

druid-restoration.reason: On each band's own fight, Restoration levels better with Heart of the Wild, all three ranks of Reflection and Bloom ahead of the top rows' other points, and Nature's Swiftness held as soon as it can be: beyond error at band 20 (round 11's pull profile, both factions) and band 30 (round 10), and no band loses.

paladin-holy.reason: On band 30's own fight, Oath of Light ahead of Infusion of Light's second rank beats the plain walk beyond error, both factions; no other band changes.

paladin-protection.reason: Holy Shield, which the rotation casts from rank 1 at 30, sits on the 21-point row; a level 30 paladin's 21 points hold it, but the plain walk spends the 21st on Improved Righteous Fury. Taking Holy Shield as soon as it fits (and Shieldsworn as soon as it fits, the capstone the spine already gave band 40) raises band 30's threat beyond error on the tank fight, both factions, seeds 1 and 50001 (sim-accuracy round 12, hybrids); damage taken rises about 2% with the Improved Righteous Fury point gone. No other band changes.

priest-discipline.reason: On band 20's own fight, Meditation ahead of Mental Agility's first rank beats the plain walk beyond error, both factions; on band 30's, Penance (which the rotation casts) ahead of Soul Warding does too; no other band changes.

priest-holy.reason: Prayer of Mending, which the rotation casts, is the Holy tree's deepest talent; the plain walk leaves it out at band 40. Taking it there, with Spiritual Healing's three ranks taken as soon as they can be held (ahead of Spiritual Guidance's last ranks), beats the plain walk beyond error, both factions; no other band changes.

shaman-restoration.reason: On band 20's own fight, Mindfulness's second rank ahead of Tidal Focus's last rank beats the plain walk beyond error, both factions; no other band changes.
